name: Crypt Ghast
oracle_text:
Extort (Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay {W/B}. If you do, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain that much life.)
Whenever you tap a Swamp for mana, add an additional {B}.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you tap a Swamp for mana, add an additional {B}.
Extort (Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay {W/B}. If you do, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain that much life.)

needs.what: a mana-choke-point effect for 'whenever you tap a <filtered land> for mana, add <fixed mana>': a filter on which lands count (subtypes Swamp) and a fixed mana string to add ({B}), resolved immediately inside payment like a mana ability (Crypt Ghast, Gauntlet of Power's land half, Wild Growth-style riders)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: double_land_mana is a boolean player static (player_doubles_land_mana) with no land filter and it adds one mana of the type the land produced, not a fixed {B}; there is no 'tapped_for_mana' trigger_event, and an add_mana ability needs to be activated rather than fired off another permanent's mana ability

needs.what: Extort: a spell_cast trigger (controller you) with an optional {W/B} payment; if paid, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain life equal to the total life actually lost that way
needs.why_existing_wont_do: spell_cast + may{pay} + lose_life is close, but lose_life has no `as` binding to read the life actually lost, so 'you gain that much life' can only be approximated by counting opponents; no extort keyword or template exists
